## Objective
- Build a complete playable game inspired by “3D Among Us rules inside a Counter-Strike round.”

## Requirements
- Build the game now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game using Canvas raycasting rather than a 3D framework.
- Assumed a single-player first-person tactical round: collect evidence at three terminals, eliminate the impostor, then defuse the bomb.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface, responsive styling, raycast-rendered ship, HUD/minimap, task puzzle, enemy AI, combat, bomb timer, and round outcomes.
- Corrected JavaScript syntax and made the task puzzle’s pulse sequence visible.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Browser verification is still pending; the browser was installed after an initial launch failed because Chromium was missing.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli` and inspect the game in-browser.
2. Test starting a round, movement/aiming, task interaction, combat, and responsive controls; fix any issues.
3. Finish with a brief summary of the game and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and overlays.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Rendering, controls, gameplay, AI, puzzles, and game state.

## Important Context
- Files are untracked/uncommitted.
- A Python HTTP server was started on port 3002.
- Browser installation completed with `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; an earlier `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium was not yet installed.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a playable browser game inspired by “3D Among Us rules inside a Counter-Strike round.”

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained Canvas raycasting game rather than a 3D framework.
- Make it a single-player tactical round: recover evidence at three terminals, eliminate the impostor, then defuse the bomb.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game UI, raycast-rendered ship, HUD/minimap, task puzzle, enemy AI, combat, bomb timer, and round outcomes.
- Browser-tested all three terminals, evidence progress, impostor elimination, bomb access, and successful round completion.
- Verified terminal puzzle completion, firing/reloading, mobile controls appearing at phone width, and no horizontal overflow.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser checks reported no console, page, or network errors.

### Active
- Test touch movement and action-button behavior.
- Recheck the favicon after reload and run final syntax checks.

2. Reload and confirm the favicon, then rerun `node --check game.js`.
